en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, and Abu Dawood, altogether from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Abu Hamza, from a man,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who is hit by a sexual impurity, so he stands in the rain until it flows upon his body, ‘Would that suffice him from the washing?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes’.
en.sarwar: 7. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa and abu Dawud all from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Muhammad ibn abu Hamzah from a man who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about a man who has had sexual relation after which he stands in the rain until water flows over his body. ‘Is this sufficient for Ghusl (bath)? He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, it is sufficient.’”
